approval.rationale: Revised recipe: an even, dark green carpet of fine fronds with no centre, cushions or larger shapes, so it tiles without a visible repeat. Cooked with gain 2.3 (linear mean 0.017 to about 0.039); in game it reads as moss on the boulders' tops, along the fallen logs and on the moss crags' upward facets, darker than the grass layers.
limitations: At full resolution the fronds are thin pale strokes on a flat green, closer to felt than to feather moss; only its colour and fine noise survive at gameplay distance.
No cushions, sporophytes or dry patches: every mossy surface is the same even green.
